title: Really beautiful but crooked
text: Really beautiful but crooked. We just ironed and hung ours up today.  They fold over the edges and stitched about a 1" hem to keep it from fraying, but when you look at the back seams along all edges, you can see how crooked the fold is and the stitching. On the wall some of the crookedness in the image is evident because of this uneven tug on the fabric. It's not a deal breaker, but if you are OCD about straight lines then you may want to pass on this one despite its beauty.  We're okay with it as is.
